defects.title: Persisted TGSRTC paths can require turns the bus controller rejects
defects.cause: Stored directed paths permit 180-degree edge reversals; assigned buses bypass special U-turn handling, while Traffic.prepare rejects turns above 158.4 degrees.

reproduction.method: Offline production Traffic with shipped pack, obstacle-free scene and fixed seed.
reproduction.leg: Kachiguda X Roads → Koti Maternity Hospital

defects.expected: A supported assigned bus route executes its legal allotted turn and reaches its next stop, or the unsupported leg is explicitly unavailable.
defects.actual: The bus remains at zero speed before the turn, serves no stop and retains an active service.
defects.affectedCountsLimit: Referenced patterns/routes contain at least one rejected join; the isolated production simulation confirms one exact stalled route, not 573 manual route drives.

defects.title: Golconda slopes leave Roadster wheels inside or above the visible surface
defects.cause: Landmark support uses the car centre. Pitch is computed only for roads and roll does not align with landmark terrain.

reproduction.method: Offline and real-time browser isolated fixture using production emitted Golconda/Player, 475 solid footprints, no input.

defects.expected: Wheel contacts and vehicle body align with the visible landable slope without deep embedding/floating.
defects.actual: The parked car stays horizontal and intersects the hillside. The flat summit positive control still passes.
